title: Chess at EWC 26 Survival Guide
text: Chess at EWC 26 Survival Guide Aug 10 New city, bigger bracket, same fast-paced chess. After an explosive debut last summer, chess returns to the 2026 Esports World Cup. From August 11 to August 15, 22 of the world’s top players will gather at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles to battle for their share of the $1,500,000 prize pool and this year’s EWC title. Chess at EWC 2026 runs from August 11 to August 15, beginning with an eight-player double-elimination Play-In on August 11, where matches consist of two games using a 10-minute time control with no increment and Armageddon as a tiebreaker. The Group Stage follows on August 12 and 13, with two groups of eight competing in double-elimination brackets under the same match format. The top eight then advance to the Playoffs on August 14 and 15, where a single-elimination bracket features four-game quarterfinals, six-game semifinals and a Grand Final played as a best-of-three sets, with the first two sets consisting of four games and a potential final set consisting of two games. The reigning champion Magnus Carlsen returns to the stage as the inaugural Esports World Cup Chess champion. Representing Team Liquid, the Norwegian grandmaster dominated the 2025 tournament in Riyadh to claim the first-ever EWC Chess title, automatically qualifying for this year’s event. He enters Paris as the favorite once again, but with an even bigger target on his back. Dangerous birds The biggest threat to Carlsen’s title defense will likely come from a stacked Team Falcons roster featuring two of his fiercest rivals: American speed-chess icon Hikaru Nakamura and Iranian-French prodigy Alireza Firouzja. Firouzja proved himself a worthy challenger in last year’s Grand Final, while Nakamura remains one of the world’s most dangerous rapid and blitz players. With both Falcons stars looking to dethrone Team Liquid’s champion, the club enters Paris with two razor-sharp claws ready to snatch the EWC trophy and secure vital points in the Club Championship race. Club Championship Chess at EWC 26 carries added importance in the Club Championship race. With Team Liquid still pointless heading into Week 6, Carlsen will need to deliver if the club is to make an impact in this year’s standings. Team Falcons, meanwhile, cannot afford to rest after securing a crucial Street Fighter 6 victory last week, with AG.AL hot on their heels and fielding Denis Lazavik in the competition. Every point will matter as Falcons look to protect their lead atop the leaderboard. Latest News From EWC 2027 ESPORTS WORLD CUP 2027 QUALIFIER PROGRAM The EWC 2027 Qualifier Program is expanding the global qualification pathway: new Direct Qualifiers and Satellite Last Chance Qualifiers will bring established tournament organisers and local competitions into Road to EWC, creating more opportunities for players around the world to compete on the global stage. 2027 COUNTER-STRIKE 2 RETURNS TO THE ESPORTS WORLD CUP IN 2027 AND 2028! Counter-Strike 2 is returning to the Esports World Cup in both 2027 and 2028, bringing two more years of world-class competition. 2026 2026 ESPORTS WORLD CUP IN NUMBERS Seven weeks. 24 games. More than 2,000 players. And a whole lot of unforgettable moments. From the biggest stages in esports to the streets of Paris, EWC26 brought the world together for a summer of competition, entertainment and community. 2026 ESPORTS WORLD CUP TROPHY AWARD CEREMONY CROWNS AG.AL Thousands of competitors have traveled to the Esports World Cup 2026 in search of glory and millions in prize money, but in the end there could only be one winner of the Club Championship. The trophy award ceremony celebrated AG.AL as the Club Championship winner while honoring the achievements of each and every player involved. SEE ALL NEWS

text: in: Modes English Chess Royale SAVE EDIT Chess Royale is a game mode that can only be played in Special Event Challenges and Party Mode. It was added to the game as a collaboration of Supercell with Chess.com. In this mode, there is a King's Tower, but no Crown Towers, and they are instead replaced with a singular tower, with a female ranger on top of it. In addition to these towers, three more towers are available on each side of the Arena. These three towers have a male ranger, a charger and a Bomber on top, representing the Bishop, Knight, and Rook from a traditional chess game. Furthermore, 8 shielders are found in front of all the towers, representing the Pawns from chess. To win the battle, players have to destroy the King's Tower before theirs is destroyed or the Queen Tower before theirs is destroyed. Towers King's Tower Main article: King's Tower The King's Tower is the main Crown Tower of this mode. The King's Tower in Chess Royale functions identically to the King's Tower in regular 1v1 battles, meaning that if it is destroyed, the battle ends immediately. Unlike in regular 1v1 battles, the King's Tower in Chess Royale is always active, regardless on whether he has been attacked or not. Queen Tower The Queen Tower is the secondary Crown Tower of this mode. It acts as a replacement for the Crown Towers from regular 1v1 battles. Destroying this tower will grant 1 Crown for the player. An Archer Queen or Mother Witch can be found on top of it, and it attacks similar to the corresponding troop. title: Clash Royale Spooky Chess Explained (Season 88): Dates, Rules, Badges, and How to Win the Shocktober League
text: Home Blog Clash Royale Spooky Chess Explained (Season 88): Dates, Rules, Badges, and How to Win the Shocktober League Clash Royale Spooky Chess Explained (Season 88): Dates, Rules, Badges, and How to Win the Shocktober League Review us on Excellent 4.9/5 Sam Okonkwo Published on October 5, 2026 • Updated October 5, 2026 TIMESAVER SERVICES Less grind in the games you play Explore available services and check what fits your game. Browse supported games Browse games Quick answer: Spooky Chess is the competitive league event of Clash Royale's Season 88 "Shocktober," and it runs from 5 October to 19 October 2026. Instead of two Princess Towers, each side defends a wall of buildings and troops in front of the King — the goal is to blast a hole through that wall and destroy the enemy King Tower while protecting your own. There are two badges: one for completing the League Road and one for finishing in the top 10,000 on the leaderboard. Supercell has not published the exact scoring formula, so read your live points from the in-game League screen rather than trusting any "guaranteed points per win" chart. Find it in the Events tab, not the Album Event interface. Spooky Chess is one of those events that looks like normal Clash Royale for about ten seconds, and then you deploy your first troop into a wall of enemy buildings and realize none of your muscle memory applies. This guide covers the exact dates, how the mode actually works, both badges, and a concrete game plan for the wall-and-King objective — grounded in what Supercell has confirmed and honest about what it hasn't. Key takeaways Spooky Chess runs 5–19 October 2026 as the Season 88 (Shocktober) competitive league. It opened on day one of the season, before the Album Event (which starts 6 October). The map is different: your Princess Towers are gone. Each side has a Mother Witch Tower and a row of support buildings/troops walling off the King. You win by destroying the enemy King Tower. Two badges: complete the League Road for one; place top 10,000 on the leaderboard for the other. They are separate goals. No official scoring table exists. Supercell confirmed the leaderboard and the top-10,000 cutoff but did not publish a points-per-win formula — use the in-game screen as the source of truth. Best plan: treat the match in two stages — clear the wall to open a lane to the King, then defend your own wall. Spell-heavy decks and splash damage shine because the targets come in clusters. When does Spooky Chess run in Clash Royale? Spooky Chess is live from 5 October to 19 October 2026. It is the headline competitive league of Season 88, the "Shocktober" season that began on 5 October 2026 when Season 87 (Minion Academy) rolled over. The timing matters because Shocktober is unusually packed and the events do not all share dates. Here is how the early-to-mid season lays out, according to Supercell's season schedule as reported across current coverage: Event Window (2026) What it is Spooky Chess 5–19 Oct The competitive league covered in this guide Shocktober: The Movie (Album Event) 6 Oct – 2 Nov Free route to the Evolution Electro Giant C.H.A.O.S Blackout 19–26 Oct Returning C.H.A.O.S variant C.H.A.O.S Draft 19 Oct – 2 Nov Draft-format C.H.A.O.S Power Surge (Global Tournament) 20 Oct – 2 Nov Global Tournament format C.H.A.O.S Power Surge 26 Oct – 2 Nov Third C.H.A.O.S variant 20-Win Challenge from 26 Oct The annual CRL 20-Win grind Because Spooky Chess ends on 19 October — the same day the C.H.A.O.S modes begin — it is the first thing you should clear if you care about badges. Don't leave it for the final week; by then it's gone. Where to find it: open the Events tab. Spooky Chess is a competitive league with its own entry point, so it will not live inside the Album Event screen. If you only open the game to tap the album, you can miss the league window entirely. How does Spooky Chess work? Spooky Chess reuses the Chess Royale format that Supercell first ran as a Chess.com collaboration back in the 2023 "King's Gambit" season, dressed in Shocktober's Halloween theme. The battlefield is turned into something closer to a chessboard, and the standard tower layout is thrown out. Here is what changes versus a normal ladder match: No Princess Towers. In their place, each side fields a Mother Witch Tower.
